text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000465 bills 99215 well above risk-adjusted expectation in every complexity tier, but the few charts returned support the billed levels, so documentation is too thin to call this upcoding.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The by-complexity table shows this provider's 99215 share running roughly double the all-provider share in every condition-count tier, including 0–1 condition patients. A sicker panel alone does not explain that, and the billing is also heavily concentrated at 99214. Against that, every documented claim supported its billed level, including low-complexity 99215 claim C0261422 (one condition, documented high MDM, 32 minutes). Only 1 of 25 moderate-plus data-reviewed notes lacked a lab or test line, so there is little sign of cloned notes. Still, 3 documented 99215 claims cannot confirm or rule out a pattern, and records cover only a small share of claims. A reviewer should first request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims, such as C0261702, C0261846, C0261993 and C0261641/C0261829 (same patient, both hypertension visits), and for a sample of 99214 claims on 0–1 condition patients such as C0261405 and C0262088, then check whether MDM and time genuinely support the billed level."}
